goal: Educational toy: design a 475-residue ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate carboxylase/oxygenase (RuBisCO) large chain capable in principle of carbon fixation. Include a plausible N-terminal domain and catalytic alpha/beta-barrel chemistry, with varied hydrophobic, polar, charged, and turn-forming residues. Avoid homopolymers or repeated short motifs. Do not copy a known sequence.
